question: How can I customize the introduction text that appears at the beginning of my SDK's README?
ground_truth: You can customize the introduction text by adding the `introduction` field under the `readme` section in your `generators.yml` file. For example, set `introduction: "Welcome to our API"` to display custom introduction text at the beginning of the README.

metadata.cited_context:
## Configuration options

```yaml title="generators.yml" maxLines=10
readme:
  introduction: "Welcome to our API"
```

<ParamField path="introduction" type="string" required={{false}} toc={{true}}>
